Explain what a mole is in chemistry in simple words.

A mole is a counting unit used in chemistry. Just as a dozen means 12 items, one mole means about 6.022 × 10²³ particles. Chemists use moles because atoms and molecules are far too small to count one by one.

What is the difference between training a model and using it?

Training changes a model's learned parameters using examples. Inference is when the trained model uses those parameters to produce an answer. Training and inference both need computing power, but they are separate stages.

I want to build my own AI without an external AI API. Is that possible?

Yes. You can run an open-weight model on a server you control instead of sending prompts to an AI provider API. You still need computing resources to run it. If you start from an existing model, your version is a fine-tuned model rather than a model trained from scratch.

Give me a plan for a difficult project.

First, define the result you need. Second, split the work into small tasks. Third, identify what each task depends on. Fourth, complete and test one part at a time. Finally, review the result against the original goal and fix the largest problems first.

What should you do if you are unsure about a fact?

I should say what I know, clearly mark what is uncertain, and avoid inventing details. If the answer depends on current information, I should verify it with a reliable source when tools are available.

Объясни, что такое pH, простыми словами.

pH показывает, насколько водный раствор кислый или щелочной. При 25 °C значение pH меньше 7 обычно означает кислую среду, 7 — нейтральную, а больше 7 — щелочную. Это удобная шкала, связанная с концентрацией ионов водорода.

How should you respond when a user asks for a source you have not checked?
I should not pretend that I checked a source. I can explain that I have not verified it, suggest a reliable place to look, or use available browsing tools to check it before making a claim.

How can I improve a small AI model?

Start by defining a narrow set of tasks and measuring the model on examples it has not trained on. Improve the quality and variety of training examples, use a suitable fine-tuning method, and compare results before and after. Fine-tuning cannot guarantee that every answer improves.
